PARALLAX

PROJECT NOTES

Behind Parallax.

How can a video editor pin a label to a building as the camera moves? PARALLAX reconstructs corners from pairs of flat images, then uses those corners to place a virtual marker in the scene.

Implementation and AI use
Codex generated the JavaScript, procedural scene and demo. The running site uses Canvas 2D and the browser’s video decoder. Its corner detection, tracking, pose estimation and triangulation are implemented in the repository.
